steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Transmission went through!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Captain? Do you copy?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm here! It's me! What's your status?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Most of us are fine. We're trapped under this building at the moment, but we found an access hatch.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We'll regroup with you if we find another exit.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We disabled the restart function. Rest assured, we've got a very defensible position. Make your way here and you won't have to worry about getting caught flat-footed.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Bluishsilver, she's...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: ...No, no, Rosmontis! Wait!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Focus on the mission... don't come for us! You promised us before we set out!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Keep your promise! We wouldn't have followed you into Chernobog without it.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Remember our talk back when we joined your team?

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Listen to me, Rosmontis... we talked about how elite operators and their teams are all different.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: You can do so much. You Arts are so strong. There's not much we can do for you in a fight.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: But when you can't handle the burden, we'll share it with you. Just like Amiya and the other elite operators.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But you're my team!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Calm down!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Bluishsilver's last wish...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Was that we help you grow as a warrior, not a soldier, and not a weapon.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Captain, you get your job done. We'll make it out of here safe.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Listen, Rosmontis. This might be hard to do. But it's what Bluishsilver wanted.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: 'You're not just an elite operator, you're Rosmontis. We all love you, not just your team, but Rhodes Island and the Infected, everyone who hates loss and destruction... we all love you.'

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: So, Captain, 'Think about what 'Rosmontis' would do, okay?'

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Over and out. Tell Amiya hi for us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't leave me. Please come back.

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: We will.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They cut the transmission.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's the situation?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh, Amiya. We lost one member of the engineering team, but the rest are safe for now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... We need a little more firepower. The guerrilla mortar team needs supplies. We'll ambush them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya, after Ace died, what did you think?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You don't have to tell me if you don't want to. But I want to know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, I don't want to think too much about it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You want to run away too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it's just not the time to face up to it. Tears are for the end, when it's all over.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I only remember the very end, I was thinking...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That I didn't want to let him, or any of our Rhodes Island operators, die in vain.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Recon Operator, tell me where. I'm going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion is totally out of control. Watch yourself.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Because we're their enemy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because everything is their enemy. Without an enemy to fight, sometimes people make their own.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What are you worried about? Vanguard group, attack!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Roger! Form up and reload!

steps.name: Defender Operator
steps.text: Roger! Hold fast! Don't let them cut off the corridor!

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Stop casting! Watch for friendly fire!

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No further! Too scary.

steps.name: Herdified Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't hit! Pain! Pain everywhere.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's an unpleasant infection symptom.

options: More disturbing than the Infected mutants in Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you want to ask if I worry about Rosmontis, Amiya, and their teams...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have to confess, there's no use worrying.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We settled on the plan, and it all runs on a predesigned track. If you squeeze onto someone else's rail, you'll just end up derailing two trains.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The herd doesn't look like it's pushing up!

options: Stay focused! We want to pass through, not wipe them out!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Clear them in waves. We don't have the capacity to take on an entire battlefield.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is a mature leader and an excellent fighter. She knows the team, the operation, and our objectives.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis is a powerhouse and the elite operator best supported by her team. She clears her mission objectives cleanly and decisively, as long as the operation utilizes her properly.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Chernobog is in the midst of a raging storm, and given the circumstances there's not much worrying about the situation can accomplish.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The most important thing we can do for them is accomplish our own team's strategic objectives.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I don't think so.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's through all seven training segments and passed every test given to her. There were three in which she showed particular promise.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I have no faith in casters like this. Kalt'sit, I pride myself on my skill with Arts, and I hope to help others with it.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: That's not what Rosmontis is. Her Originium Arts are not those that serve to benefit mankind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I want her to fight, but for one consideration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Rosmontis spent her whole life in the greenhouse, her outburst once reality shatters her beautiful world would be catastrophic.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: If you can't do it, I will.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Pith!

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: You and Amiya have too much faith in the future. One misstep and someone else's future is gone forever.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before we make a judgment like that, we have to at least try.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I'm worried about a future that's beyond saving.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For now, I'll have her serve as an elite operator. Not in the future, but now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right now, we teach her, polish her, forge her strength into shape, hold her to the highest standards, and watch her stand firm in the face of Catastrophe.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Until there is nothing in the world that can shake her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only then will she be free of the terrible fate the Columbians set out for her. Only then can she lead her own life.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That is my goal.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: I knew you'd say something like that, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Pith
steps.text: But who's responsible for her?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I need you to work with me. I need the elite operators on this together.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And I promise you, I stake my life on it. We will see this through.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A war cast in warmth and kindness is a much more dangerous form of war.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't want to speak of such horrible cruelties, even if my fears should never come to pass.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya and Rosmontis are in the care of Rhodes Island herself, and more directly the elite operators who take responsibility for them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Further, they are the core of the squad's strategy, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Trust in them, and you trust in yourself.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, Hawk, did you see that?

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: How could I not?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Shhh. Don't give us away.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Then why did you ask me? You're the one making noise.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (I said shhhh. You don't want the Captain to chew you out.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (She can't talk, how would I know if she's chewing me out, or if it's just you pretending for her?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (I wouldn't do that.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (I know.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (I mean...)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Enough. I know you want to ask about this stuff.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (You've got all these weapon and armor cases, all this machinery laid out all nice. If it was just laying around I'd say I came up with a million Victorian pounds or so.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (I bet you two big ones that's Ursus stuff. I saw goods like this when I was smuggling around Laval. This is brand spanking new.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (You got the Central Corps, but other units can't have had anything like this more than... Hmm, maybe five years?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (You think it makes any sense that Reunion could've just looted all this equipment?)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (You mean the guys who go around swinging pipes? I don't think they'd even know how to grease it.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (What about the guerrillas? They're ex-Ursus Army.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (How long ago did they desert? Those big, heavy metal guys would sink if you pushed them into a lake.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Even if they managed to bring some logistics units with them all those years ago, they'd probably all be dead by now.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Think about it. With the stuff they're using now, it's a miracle they can keep their plates wiped clean.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Let them get their hands on these weapons? I doubt they'd even know which end to point at the enemy.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (You're making them sound like a bunch of idiots.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Ignorance and idiocy aren't the same thing. Logistics is skill as much as it's knowledge. The guerrillas aren't dumb, but the odds that they'll come across some Infected logistics officers eager to run off with them are pretty slim.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Saving an Infected officer from execution... that's a tall order.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (Look... The serial number's been filed off. Sure, a deserter might do that, but you know who else might...?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (You might do it if you were trying to trick somebody.)

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: (It wasn't done very clean. Just looking at it I can tell what kind of file they used. Looks like somebody was short on time.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But the most important thing for now...

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: We have to tell them, and quick. Whether or not it's useful info.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I just hope we're not too late. Captain, should we have Raidian tell Amiya's team? Or go report it direct?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We should keep Reunion and the weird looking guys busy back here? Got it.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: We've got bogeys closing on our position.

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Mantra, you on it? Just make them forget what they're doing. No need to fabricate some orders or turn them into gibbering morons or whatever...

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Conserve your strength. If we run into Reunion, we'll need you to defuse the situation.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hm? Hm.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: 'Good. Be careful.'

steps.name: Hawk
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Okay... And it's good to send, Captain. Here.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: 'The Ursus Army is in the core city.'
